about: kael-v3's Personagens Leve (tools/scripts/sprites/quality_copies.py, the rule of 2026-10-25): every clip of cut.json from the same matted frames, at most 36 frames picked evenly (no blend, the clip's timing kept), the figure ~610 px tall (a clip already shorter keeps its own size).
figureNote: each clip's median head top to boot row, about as tall as kael-final-002's idle (519 px of 528 at box h 2.656: 2.61 units with the hair)

clips.video: Attachments/KaelV3/supersize/ATT.mp4 (cropped x 225..1875 as the 720p one: build/video-cut/kael-v3d/ATT-cropped.mp4)

wallKey.why: the user, 2026-11-21: "the lightning doesnt end at his edges": the arcs kept past his body (the matte drops them)

edgeKeyWhy: the user, 2026-11-09: "the last batch didn't turn out too good because of very large grey borders", "this cloak has the most grey": v02 cuts every clip with video_sprite.py's edge_key (the soft edge read between the figure's colour and the wall's); v01 stays on disk
bodyAtWhy: the user, 2026-11-10: "the transition from att back to idle of Kael is the worst I've ever seen": every standing pose has his head where the idle (base) has it, -0.19 units from the card's centre, or he jumps sideways as a pose starts and ends

light.why: the user, 2026-11-11, Kael beside Isolde on the board: "look at how his light doesnt match". Every video matched to the attack's standing frames, then the set's grade: warmer (the face's red over green 1.6 -> 1.8, as the other heroes' faces), deeper shadows and a face about as bright as theirs (tools/scripts/sprites/match_set_light.py)
